summary: Castellum, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing via Item 8.01 that it will participate in the 2026 Maxim Group Growth Summit on October 14, 2026, with management holding one-on-one institutional investor meetings. The filing attaches the October 12, 2026 press release as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, financing, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is a routine investor-conference announcement and not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
